semiconductor_relevance: High — B.E.S.T Fluidsysteme GmbH, operating as Swagelok München, provides critical fluid system solutions specifically tailored for the semiconductor industry.
summary: B.E.S.T Fluidsysteme GmbH, under the Swagelok brand, specializes in high-quality fluid system components essential for semiconductor manufacturing. Their offerings include valves, fittings, and tubing designed to ensure purity and precision in critical applications, supporting both R&D and volume production.
capabilities: Flow control components including regulators and meters
